task_completion.description: The MRHead.nrrd volume is loaded into 3D Slicer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'MRHead' volume name is visible in the Data module or the slice viewers (Red/Green/Yellow views).

task_completion.description: The Segment Editor module is open and a new segment is created.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Segment Editor' module interface is visible, and a segment entry exists in the segments table.
The text 'BrainTissue' is visible in the segment list within the Segment Editor or Data module.

task_completion.description: The Threshold effect is selected and a range is applied to isolate brain tissue.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Threshold' button is highlighted in the Segment Editor, and a colored mask (overlay) appears over the brain matter in the slice viewers.

task_completion.description: The segmentation mask covers gray/white matter while excluding the skull and background.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The colored overlay is confined to the inner brain area; there is a clear gap between the mask and the outer skull/scalp boundaries.

task_completion.description: The segmentation is exported to the specified file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export to files' dialog or 'Save Data' dialog is visible with the destination path set to '~/Documents/SlicerData/Exports/brain_segmentation.seg.nrrd'.

integrity.description: The agent used the 3D Slicer GUI rather than just executing background scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Slicer buttons, sliders, and the Segment Editor panel.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename an existing file to satisfy the export requirement.
integrity.visual_evidence: The progression shows the manual adjustment of threshold sliders and the 'Apply' button being clicked.

integrity.description: The task is performed within the 3D Slicer application interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: The standard 3D Slicer window layout, including the module selector and the four-up slice view, is present.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The MRHead volume typically requires a threshold range that captures the main histogram peak of the brain tissue (often between 50 and 280 intensity units). The final file must be saved specifically as 'brain_segmentation.seg.nrrd' in the Exports folder.
